items.meta_description: Run your own VPN service from one panel: add a server with a single command, set your own plans, hand out access keys, and watch it all live. Free for up to 5 servers.
items.page_desc: Run your own VPN without becoming a system administrator. VpnHood! MANAGER is the panel where you add your servers, decide what your users get, and hand out access with a single key, whether that is for your family, your community, or your customers.
items.free_note: Free for up to 5 servers, 5 farms, 2,000 access keys, and 3 team members, with an Unlimited plan when you outgrow it. You bring the server; a VPS from any cloud provider is the only thing you pay for.
items.features_title: Your own VPN service, up and running today
items.features_desc: Everything it takes to run a VPN people actually pay for, without the parts nobody enjoys.
items.f_install_desc: Paste a single line on any Linux or Windows server and it installs itself, configures itself, and shows up in your panel. Rather not touch a terminal? Hand us the SSH login and we will do it for you.
items.f_key_title: Your users just paste a key
items.f_key_desc: Send them an access key. They install VpnHood! CLIENT, paste it once, and they are connected. Nothing to import, nothing to explain, no support ticket.
items.f_plans_desc: Decide once what a plan is worth: how many devices, how much traffic a month, what speed, how long it lasts. Then issue as many keys against it as you like.
items.f_farm_desc: A server farm spreads traffic across all the servers in it, giving the strongest ones the biggest share. Add another server and it starts carrying users straight away.
items.f_unblock_desc: On supported hosts you can order a fresh IP from the panel and release the old one. Point your farm at a token URL and your users' apps pick up the new address on their own, so nobody has to resend a thing.
items.f_tls_desc: Every farm gets its own TLS certificate. Own a domain? We issue and renew a trusted one through Let's Encrypt for free. Or bring the certificate you already have.
items.f_live_title: See it all, as it happens
items.f_live_desc: Which servers are up, who is online right now, how fast traffic is moving, which countries it comes from, and where every gigabyte went.
items.f_team_title: Bring your team, or your code
items.f_team_desc: Invite people and give each the role you choose. Or hand a bot an API key: every screen in the panel is the same REST API you can build on.
items.why_desc: No. VpnHood! SERVER ships with a small built-in file-based access manager, so you can run a server on your own with no panel at all. MANAGER is what you add when one server becomes several: load balancing between them, monitoring and reports, user management, and an interface you can brand as your own.
